snippet.title: Cronos: The New Dawn | Gameplay Showcase
snippet.description:
Imagine being trapped in a room with a monstrous enemy, growing stronger and more terrifying with every corpse it consumes. That’s exactly the nightmare scenario that unfolds in this intense scene set inside the Jędruś hardware store in Cronos: The New Dawn! 

Coming to PC, PlayStation5 and Xbox Series X/S this fall! 

Wishlist Cronos: The New Dawn!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2101960/Cronos_The_New_Dawn/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011556
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9p7tflq7ctxn
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/cronos-the-new-dawn-85b409

Follow Cronos on official channels:
X: https://x.com/CronosNewDawn 
Insta: https://www.instagram.com/cronosnewdawn/
www: https://cronosnewdawn.com/

Music: 
“TITAN” - Michael Werner Maas 
“INSIDIOUS” - Harel Tsemah/Itamar Carmel/Itay Steinberg/Or Kribos 
Published by: Universal Music Publishing
